notes.title: Updated Demo 1.2
notes.content:
It has been over a week since Sadko became available to Steam users. During this time, we have received valuable feedback from the first players and are ready to show how we have responded to it. The updated demo build of Sadko is now available!

[b]Technical Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] An explosive wave after completing the construction phase now repels all nearby enemies, giving you a moment to breathe.
[*] Ability usage has been remapped to mouse buttons instead of "Q" and "E."
[*] Difficulty balance has been adjusted for smoother progression and a more moderate game start.
[/list]

[b]Audio-Visual Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a visual effect when taking damage.
[*] Added audio and visual effects when picking up hero upgrades.
[*] Added a sound effect for collecting resources.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The monument no longer has an "invisible wall."
[*] Fixed the bug where resources would spawn during game pauses.
[*] Default sound and music volume have been reduced.
[*] The "sound" and "music" icons are now in their correct positions.
[*] A secret passage outside the map has been closed.
[*] Updated colliders for many objects.
[/list]

[b]Thank you so much for your feedback and the time you’ve dedicated to the project![/b]
Feel free to share your criticism in the game reviews on Steam — this will help us improve!

notes.title: Demo is now available to everyone!
notes.content:
We’ve been working towards this for a long time (almost) and finally made it! Now, any player can try out the core mechanics of the game thanks to the free demo version.
Of course, it’s still vastly different from what we’ll show at release, but it already includes the most important part – battling hordes of evil creatures coming from all directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439580/f4528dd0aac44a6773417f508e236d4527ee02cf.png[/img]

[h2]Since the first announcements, the following has been added to the game:[/h2]
[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skins for each type of mob
[*] New location objects (all those little details that bring the location to life – flowers, bushes)
[*] Water bodies and elevation changes on the map
[*] Objects for all new locations (only level design work remains)
[*] Floating damage numbers when the hero or enemies take damage
[*] The interface has been almost completely updated (but this is far from final)
[*] A new interactive story scene with basic animations
[*] Completely reworked level design
[/list]
[b]Technical:[/b]
[list]
[*] Knockback effect for enemies when attacked
[*] Enemy AI that allows them to find the shortest path to the hero
[*] Fixed resource spawn points
[*] Difficulty balance tuning without restrictions on progression
[*] New parameters and upgrades (attack radius, range, health)
[*] Localization in English and Russian
[*] Smooth camera tracking for the hero
[/list]
[b]Audio:[/b]
[list]
[*] Two additional music tracks
[*] Sound and effects for the hero taking damage
[/list]
Over the next month, the demo will be continuously updated in real-time based on player feedback. So, please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts!

[b]In future versions of the demo build, we’ll also showcase:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ranged enemies
[*] New skills and the ability to create your own build
[*] The first boss fight
[*] The second location where the first boss resides
[*] In-game tutorial through gameplay
[/list]
To see what’s coming next, add the game to your wishlist! We’ll keep you updated on all major updates and periodically share news with those who are already waiting for the game with us.

notes.title: Who is Sadko and why does he fight with gusli*
notes.content:
Sadko is a mix of two genres - Idle Tycoon Arcade and Vampire Survivors. With the blend of fast-paced action and laid-back resource gathering, you get a gameplay loop where you collect resources, constantly upgrade your stats, unlock new areas, and don't forget about the battles that literally chase you everywhere!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439580/0f4dffda287c62f23c3c75b81350c8de2af89733.png[/img]

[h2]Who is Sadko and why is he doing this?[/h2]
Sadko is a hero from Slavic epics who got fabulously rich because of his talent and skill at playing a musical instrument called the gusli*. In our game, he’s been called to help develop the city of Belozero, which is crawling with all kinds of nasty creatures. However, it’s been noted that these local evil beings are absolutely terrified of the sound of the letter "O." And guess what? Sadko is famous for his amazing "O" all over the world!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439580/d7fe842eedc466cbc3cd3df19d527be1b4912647.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439580/51794a1da276578f2b913a23b85de4db559ef869.png[/img][/url]
* [b]The gusli[/b] is a traditional string plucked musical instrument that was popular in Kievan Rus.

[h2]What's special about your project?[/h2]
In the project, we're focusing on responsive gameplay, vibrant visuals, and dynamic action to keep players engaged. And we hope that the [b]quirky voiceover[/b], which [b]uses just one letter[/b], will be a memorable touch!

[h2]How many people are working on the project?[/h2]
There are five of us in total – a game designer, a narrative designer, a programmer, and two 3D artists. We're a small but tight-knit team, and each week we add a little more to "Sadko."

[h2]When can I play?[/h2]
The earlier demo is already available on itch.io—it's what bwe managed to create in a week/b during the "Sineus" hackathon (where, by the way, we took one of the two winning spots). Right now, we're working hard to show players a complete demo with all our improvements by February 24, 2025. We're expecting the full release at the end of spring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439580/6b72cf4b5f210e6b640d3afaf80c49e5b30d5f4a.png[/img]
We're so glad to have you as part of our audience/gamers/subscribers—your support means a lot to us and our project. If you're interested in what we're doing or in our team, please add "Sadko" to your wishlist, and we'll do our best to make sure you won't be disappointed! ❤️
